questions.cardDe: Eine kugelsichere Weste rettete Reichskanzler Otto von Bismarck 1866 bei einem Revolverattentat das Leben. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Wer verübte 1866 in Berlin ein Revolverattentat auf Otto von Bismarck, das dieser fast unverletzt überlebte?
questions.en: Who carried out a revolver assassination attempt on Otto von Bismarck in Berlin in 1866, which he survived almost unharmed?

timeline.labelEn: Ferdinand Cohen-Blind fires five revolver shots at Otto von Bismarck on Unter den Linden in Berlin
timeline.labelDe: Ferdinand Cohen-Blind feuert Unter den Linden in Berlin fünf Revolverschüsse auf Otto von Bismarck ab

questions.notes: The card's statement is false: Bismarck wore no bulletproof vest – three bullets only grazed him and two glanced off his ribs. In 1866 he was Prussian Minister President, not yet Reichskanzler (from 1871). Reworked into an open question about the attacker.

questions.en: What kind of creature is Cerberus, the guardian at the entrance to the underworld in Greek mythology?

timeline.labelEn: Hesiod's Theogony names Cerberus, the many-headed hound guarding the underworld
timeline.labelDe: Hesiods Theogonie nennt Kerberos, den mehrköpfigen Hund, der die Unterwelt bewacht

questions.notes: Card offered three options (the intended answer: he barks, being a dog). Reworked into an open question about what Cerberus is; usually described as three-headed. Accept 'Hund', 'Höllenhund', 'dreiköpfiger Hund'.
